notes.title: Update 1.0.1.2 is here! Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Comrade, this is Icarus station!!
We send our greetings from Saturn orbit and wish you a Happy New Year! May it bring inspiration, unexpected discoveries and many exciting adventures - both in life and in games. And now for the most interesting part - the update! 
We are working hard to update the English translation of the game and localize it into Chinese. We will soon release an update with brand new English voiceovers.
The voice acting is done by professional actors in a studio under the guidance of an experienced sound engineer, making our characters sound more vivid and natural. We hope that this will make the game even more accessible and emotionally engaging for our international players!
We also want to thank each and every one of you for your support throughout the 2024 game.
Your feedback, kind words and suggestions are what keeps us improving and evolving.
Stay tuned to our social media channels:

[url=https://discord.gg/t9g5PyVrRy]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@SatelliteOdyssey]YouTube[/url]

And don't forget that the next chapter in our series, “Satellite Odyssey: Jupiter” is in development!
The demo is scheduled for release in late spring, so be sure to add the game to your wishlist on Steam to stay up to date.: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352140/Satellite_Odyssey_Jupiter/
Happy New Year, friends! May this year be one of new horizons and great achievements! 
Yours truly,
The Satellite Odyssey Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]New Features and Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a second ending: You now have a choice between two different game finales.
[*] New questline: Explore a new series of tasks that unlock access to a closed location.
[*] Horror elements: New frightening moments have been added to create a tense atmosphere and enhance the overall experience.
[*] Arcade machine activated: The arcade machine is now playable.
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New achievements added: Extra rewards for those aiming to complete the game 100%.
[*] Dispatcher room dialogue revised: The dialogue has been reworked for deeper immersion and atmosphere.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed auto-resolution bug: Issues with proper screen resolution recognition have been resolved.
[*] Fixed puzzle answer bug: Now, when the correct item is thrown at Zarja, she responds correctly without interrupting her dialogue if the item was thrown at her.
[*] Animation adjustments: Some animations have been updated for smoother and more realistic movements.
[*] Graphics settings fixed: Graphics settings have been improved for better performance.
[/list]

We read all your feedback and are aware that many players have commented on the unprofessional voice acting. We’ve already made arrangements with a voiceover studio and are currently casting actors for the roles of Laska and Mikhail. According to our plans, by the end of October, we’ll release a patch with new Russian voice acting. The English voiceover will also be updated later. Additionally, we plan to fully localize the game into Chinese. We’ll provide updates on all these developments soon!
In October, we will begin developing the next part of our game series, Satellite Odyssey! Stay tuned for updates!
Thanks to your reviews, we learn about bugs and shortcomings in our game! If you encounter any issues during your playthrough, please reach out so we can fix them!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated Nameplates: Replaced the nameplates on the character rooms to match their names and surnames in the game.
[*] Tooltip Pop-ups: Added pop-up tooltips for text in the environment. Since all room names and signs in the game are in Russian, this tool will help if you need its English translation. This feature will be adapted for other languages along with subtitle localization in the future.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Interaction Animations: Improved animations for character interactions with objects.
[*] Cursor: The cursor no longer appears after minimizing the game, pausing, or exiting to the menu.
[*] Dispatcher Panel Bug: Fixed an issue where interaction with the dispatcher panel would not work if a piece of evidence in the lab was examined during a dialogue.
[*] Zarya and the Crowbar: Fixed a bug where the crowbar pickup line would not play if the crowbar was picked up before Zarya closed the door to the second floor.
[*] Automat Interactions: Fixed an issue where controls would break when interacting with the soda and cigarette machines during a dialogue with Zarya.
[*] Typos: Corrected various typos in the game text.
[*] Flashlight: The flashlight now dims when approaching objects instead of disappearing completely.
[*] Basement Quest: For the quest involving the grate in the basement, you now only need to place 2 boxes to progress. You can also run through the obstacle.
[/list]

[b]Important:[/b]
Old saves will not work on the current build version.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, comrades! This is Icarus station speaking![/b]

A few days ago, on August 30th, we launched our first project, Satellite Odyssey: Prologue!
Players from different corners of Earth have completed our game in various languages already! English, German, Chinese, Hungarian, French... We are thrilled that our work resonates with people! We will soon work on localizing the subtitles for several languages to make the experience more comfortable for everyone!
Over the past three days, we’ve analyzed hundreds of your reviews and messages, fixed dozens of minor and major bugs, and paid close attention to your suggestions for improving the game. Today, we are excited to present our first patch!

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Subtitles have been reviewed and corrected. They now match the characters' lines. If we missed something, please let us know!
[*] You can now earn achievements by listening to audio recordings! Give it a try!
[*] We fixed a save bug that caused saves disappear.
[*] We adjusted sound levels. Now, streamers won’t jump at the sound of the radio. We apologize to the viewers!
[*] There is only one key to be taken. You can no longer stock up on them.
[*] We worked on reducing audio overload that occurred on weaker processors. If it still happens after the update, please let us know!
[*] Plus many other bug fixes!
[/list]

Thanks to your numerous reviews, we learn about bugs and shortcomings in our game! If you encounter any issues during your playthrough, please reach out so we can fix them!
